newsitem.title: UK: LLoyds shares up on mortgage move.
newsitem.headline: LLoyds shares up on mortgage move.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds TSB Plc touched a record high on Monday, buoyed by reports of strength in the housing market and by Abbey National Plc's decision to raise mortgage rates, traders said.
The stock was up 7p at 419-1/2 by 0922 GMT after earlier touching a record 422p -- surpassing their previous peak of 418p set October 15.
Some said there were signs of switching out of Barclays Plc, down 5-1/2p at 10.18 stg, and into Lloyds.
Weekend press reports said there were signs of increasing activity in the UK housing market, with Nationwide building society reporting an eight percent rise in prices in the year to November.
Separately Abbey National said it was raising its base mortgage rate by a quarter point to 7.29 percent.
"It is all looking good for the mortgage people," said one market maker in UK banking shares. LLoyds owns Cheltenham & Gloucester, a former building society.
